title: The Jewel of Medina
author: Sherry Jones
current_text: Random House cancelled the 2008 release of The Jewel of Medina by Sherry Jones over concerns about possible inflammatory content. After the novel appeared in Serbia in August 2008, the Serbian publisher Beobook withdrew it from stores following strong reactions from the Serbian Muslim community, then returned it to shelves shortly after. The government banned The Jewel of Medina in Malaysia in 2009.

sources.quote: The government banned 22 books in 2009, at least three due to religious content: The Jewel of Medina, The Trouble with Islam Today, and Ibrahim and Sarah.
sources.title: 2010 Report on International Religious Freedom - Malaysia | Refworld

sources.quote: Although the novel was originally scheduled for release in 2008 by Random House , it was cancelled due to concerns about possible inflammatory content.
